note: Regression corpus for the deterministic classifier in src/lib/state_rules.ts. IMPORTANT LIMITATION: these cases were written by the same author as the rules, so agreement here measures SELF-CONSISTENCY, not accuracy. It catches a refactor that breaks behaviour; it does not tell you the labels are right. Real accuracy requires messages collected independently of the rule table — add yours to `field` as you write them during TRAIN sessions and keep the two sets reported separately.
